intro: Today's updates highlight major infrastructure investments and ambitious new AI research breakthroughs. Big tech companies are securing massive energy resources while expanding their capabilities in mathematics and legal automation.

must_know.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
must_know.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar outlined a strategy to increase AI accessibility through full-stack infrastructure improvements, including a new 1GW data center project in Michigan. This initiative is part of the broader Stargate infrastructure expansion.
must_know.why_it_matters: Highlights the massive physical and energy infrastructure scale required to sustain current AI development roadmaps.

must_know.title: Google’s power-hungry data centers crave nuclear energy
must_know.summary: Google has signed a 20-year agreement with Constellation to support the upgrading of six nuclear power plants in the U.S. to supply electricity for its data centers.
must_know.why_it_matters: Illustrates the massive power requirements of AI infrastructure and the tech industry's turn toward nuclear energy for sustainable growth.

must_know.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
must_know.summary: OpenAI has published results on unsolved mathematical problems generated by an internal frontier model. The release includes Lean proof formalizations made available on GitHub.
must_know.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the growing capability of AI to contribute to formal mathematical research and verification.

hardware.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
hardware.summary: AI computing startup Lambda is raising $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation, with plans for an IPO in 2027.
hardware.why_it_matters: Signals sustained, massive investor appetite for companies building physical AI compute infrastructure.

research.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
research.summary: Jump Trading is utilizing OpenAI's models to scale and structure its quantitative research workflows. The integration supports data analysis and citation-backed insight generation.
research.why_it_matters: Shows how financial firms are integrating LLMs into specialized, high-stakes research processes.

research.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
research.summary: OpenAI and Ironclad are partnering to train and evaluate AI agents on specialized legal contracting workflows. The effort aims to improve the effectiveness of computer-use agents in professional settings.
research.why_it_matters: Advances the practical application of AI agents in complex, document-heavy enterprise environments.

research.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
research.summary: Google DeepMind has introduced EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open-source, lightweight multimodal embedding model.
research.why_it_matters: Expands the set of efficient, open-weights tools available for developers building multimodal applications.

research.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
research.summary: Musubi has released PolicyLM-1.7B, an open-weights, lightweight model designed for real-time content moderation decision-making.
research.why_it_matters: Provides a specialized, accessible tool for developers to implement automated moderation at scale.

continuing.title: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
continuing.summary: OpenAI released 722 manuscripts detailing solutions to mathematical problems, which were authored by an unreleased frontier model. These findings continue to provoke debate regarding research ethics and the role of AI in academic math.
continuing.why_it_matters: Raises broader questions about how AI-generated research should be integrated into professional academic communities.
continuing.update_delta: The news highlights the specific volume of 722 manuscripts and the subsequent debate among mathematicians regarding ethics and oversight.
